ports.scripts/joy_teleop_node.py: ROS 2 adaptation of smb_teleop_twist_joy_node.cpp using its axis/button mappings and original launch velocity scales.
ports.scripts/velocity_mux_node.py: New ROS 2 arbitration adapter implementing the source priorities, source TTL and Bool lock configuration; not a copy of the external twist_mux package implementation.
ports.config/teleop.yaml: Original mapping and scale defaults, with explicit Joy freshness, neutral release and polling settings.

intentional_changes: Validate Joy indices and values; toggle lock on button rising edges rather than every pressed message.
Stop on stale Joy and emit one zero at neutral instead of indefinitely refreshing old or neutral velocity ownership.
Consume soft_emergency_stop as a lock plus PCI cancellation; the fixed original repository only had its publisher.
Route autonomous tracking through external/cmd_vel rather than the original direct-controller mux bypass.
On manual takeover publish zero before asynchronous pci_stop; cancel once per takeover or new blocked goal rather than per manual message.

After cancellation query execution_state/tracking_state/control_state, require idle and auto=false, then require each Action layer to accept a new UUID before forwarding subsequently received external Twist.
Unlocking does not replay cached commands or restore a canceled autonomous task.

Recognize an explicitly admitted GROUND_MANEUVER in both Action layers when reopening after manual takeover; require active RUNNING/SETTLING state and retain each new UUID/counter, retired-goal and lock conditions. BRAKING cannot reopen the gate.
